CommunityApplications.Profile: junkerderprovinz. This repository (featherdrop) was the first template submitted to Community Applications; all current apps and templates have since moved to the unraid-apps repository. Browse the full catalog there: own-image containers (BombVault, featherdrop, JDownloader, Krusader, PrusaSlicer, Stellarium, Matrix, OpenCloud), upstream-image wrappers (CouchDB, OpenHands, Standard Notes Server, Standard Notes Web UI, n8n), and the ShipLog and FireSquire plugins. Support via the per-app Unraid forum threads.
